pipeline.stage: 1a. image derivation - generate multiview from front reference
pipeline.note: Tripo regenerates a consistent 4-view (front/left/back/right) turnaround from a single input image. Used as the base for the arms-apart edit below (per the work order: derive the A-pose variant with Tripo's own tooling, not by feeding the raw pressed-arms views straight to generation).
pipeline.output_saved_as: assets/kitty/derived/kitty-multiview-base-front.jpg (front view only, for reference; back/left/right were intermediate and superseded by the edited set)

pipeline.prompt_applied_to_all_four_views: Keep this exact same chubby cartoon cat unchanged in every way -- same warm yellow-orange fur color, same cream belly patch, same big round green eyes, same face, same head tufts, same curled tail -- but change only the pose: lift both short arms up and away from the sides of the torso into a relaxed A-pose, so there is a clear, visible gap of open background space between each arm and the flank/belly, with the rounded paws no longer touching the body. Also move the two legs slightly further apart at a relaxed stance. Do not change color, proportions, face, or tail.
pipeline.result: Tripo raised both arms into a symmetric overhead 'cheer' pose with a large, unambiguous gap to the torso on all views (front/back very clean; right view shows a slightly lower/more casual arm angle than front/left/back, a minor cross-view inconsistency that did not visibly harm the generated mesh).

pipeline.note: Single attempt was sufficient: the arms-apart derived images produced a mesh with the arms clearly separated from the torso by open space (inspected via the rendered_image preview and via the project's own matplotlib-based mesh renderer before rigging).

An earlier rig attempt with spec=mixamo (task c722e95a-fd56-4b0c-a4ca-ef16c742f7c8, 25 credits) produced Mixamo-style bone names directly, but animate_retarget then failed (error 1004) against that rig for every preset -- Tripo's preset animation library appears to require the native 'tripo' bone spec. Re-rigged with spec=tripo (this task) and retargeted successfully; joints were renamed to Mixamo-style names (see 'joint_rename' below) as a cosmetic, index-preserving relabel afterwards so validator name-pattern matching (arm|hand|shoulder|clavicle|...) still works.

discarded_attempt.reason_discarded: animate_retarget rejected this rig for every preset animation (error_code 1004) -- presets require spec=tripo bone naming

pipeline.stage: 5d. animation - wave (authored, no Tripo preset exists)
pipeline.note: Tripo's preset library (checked via the retarget docs) offers: idle, walk, run, dive, climb, jump, slash, shoot, hurt, fall, turn, and quadruped/hexapod/octopod/serpentine/aquatic marches -- no 'wave'. Per the work order this is explicitly permitted: the wave clip is hand-keyframed directly on the generated rig's own joints (RightArm/RightForeArm), using the idle clip's neutral standing pose (sampled at t=0) as the constant baseline for every other joint so the wave clip's rest stance matches idle/jump/walk instead of the raw arms-apart bind pose. Mesh and skeleton remain 100% Tripo-generated; only these animation curves are hand-authored.

All four clips share one skeleton+skin (they all trace back to rig task 1d1915e1-...). Channels were copied by joint NAME (not raw index) from each source clip onto one base rigged model, per the work order.
pipeline.joint_rename_map: scripts/pipeline/joint_rename_map.json (cosmetic node-name relabel, tripo spec -> Mixamo-style names; does not touch node indices, skin, or animation data)

discarded_or_failed_tripo_tasks.reason: accidental connectivity/auth smoke-test against the v3 endpoint pattern before discovering v2 was the working surface; not part of the asset pipeline

scripts_used.tripo_client.py: Minimal v2 openapi client (upload/create_task/poll/download); reads TRIPO_API_KEY from the environment only.
scripts_used.keyframe_wave.py: Authors the 'wave' clip on the rig's own RightArm/RightForeArm joints, FK-consistent, pinned to the idle-neutral pose on every other joint.
scripts_used.merge_clips.py: Copies animation channels (matched by joint name) from the separate idle/jump/walk/wave clip GLBs onto one base rigged GLB with a single skeleton+skin; also applies the cosmetic joint rename.
scripts_used.gltf_anim.py: Shared glTF FK + linear-blend-skinning evaluator used by keyframe_wave.py, verify_kitty.py, and render_preview.py.
scripts_used.verify_kitty.py: Self-verification report: skin/joint counts, triangle count, textures, clip durations, and wave-specific numbers (arm rotation, oscillation count, root/hips translation range, torso vertex displacement).
scripts_used.render_preview.py: CPU-only orthographic preview renderer (matplotlib painter's-algorithm rasterizer) used to render assets/kitty/previews/wave-*.png and to visually inspect the mesh/pose before and after rigging.
